verses.text: These are more proverbs/wise sayings from Solomon:
Money that you get by doing dishonest/wicked things will really not benefit you;
Yahweh does not allow righteous people to starve,
Lazy people soon become poor;
Those who are wise, harvest the crops when they are ripe;
Righteous people will be blessed by God;
After righteous people die, other people are blessed as they remember what those people did before they died;
Wise people heed good instruction/advice,
Honest people will be safe,
Those who signal with their eyes that they are about to do something that is wrong cause trouble,
What righteous people say [MTY] is like a fountain that ◄gives life/enables people to live many years► [MET],
When we hate others, it causes quarrels,
Those who have good sense say [MTY] what is wise,
Wise people continue to learn all that they can,
The wealth that rich people have protects them like a city is protected by a strong wall around it [MET],
If you are righteous, your reward will be a good life,
Those who pay attention when others try to ◄correct them/teach them what they are doing that is wrong► will live ◄happily/for many years►;
Those who will not admit that they hate others are liars,
When people talk a lot, that will lead them to sin a lot by what they say;
What righteous/good people say [MTY] is as valuable as pure silver [MET];
What righteous people say [MTY] benefits many people,
Yahweh blesses some people by enabling them to become rich,
Foolish people ◄have fun/enjoy► doing what is wrong,
Righteous people will get the good things that they want/desire,
When storms come, the wicked will ◄be blown away/never be safe►,
We do not like a lazy person who refuses to do the job that he is given to do,
If you revere Yahweh, you will live for a long time;
Righteous people confidently expect that good things will happen to them, and that causes them to be happy/joyful;
Yahweh protects [MET] those who live righteously,
Righteous people will always be secure [LIT],
Righteous people [MTY] say things that are wise,
Righteous people [MTY] know what to say that is acceptable,
